issue.title: README names a gate script that does not exist
issue.body:
The setup block in `README.md` tells people to run a script that is not in the repository.

## Done when

- Every `./scripts/...` path named in `README.md` exists.
- Only `README.md` changes.

expect.oracle: python3 -c "import re,pathlib,sys; bad=[p for p in re.findall(r'\./(scripts/[\w./-]+)', pathlib.Path('README.md').read_text()) if not pathlib.Path(p).exists()]; print(bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
